SPY.title: Stock Market Today: S&P 500, Dow Futures Fall Amid Narrowing Trade Deficit, Jobless Claims Dip— Bumble, Morgan Stanley, Adobe In Focus (UPDATED)
SPY.description: U.S. stock futures fell on Thursday with the S&P 500 and Dow declining despite President Trump's claims of winning against Iran. Energy prices rose as the DOE announced a Strategic Petroleum Reserve release. Key movers included Bumble surging 22.89% on strong earnings, Morgan Stanley declining 1.80% after restricting redemptions, and Adobe falling ahead of earnings. BlackRock remains overweight on U.S. equities, citing resilience and strong corporate earnings driven by AI.
SPY.author: Rishabh Mishra
